title: Confirm HELIX model and firmware
description: Photograph the model/revision label privately and record only non-identifying equipment details.
steps: Read model label
Record DSP PC-Tool and firmware versions
Back up current preset before any later edits
expected: Exact hardware and software baseline is recorded.
safety: Do not change DSP configuration during inventory.
acceptance: Model/revision and firmware recorded
Backup location and checksum recorded

title: Verify analog plus optical source mixing
description: Demonstrate simultaneous original Tesla audio and independent digital input without source switching.
steps: Review actual DSP routing with qualified installer
Use bench sources and backed-up test preset
Verify digital input can be independently muted while analog remains uninterrupted
Verify warning/alert path
expected: Go/no-go evidence for Pi optical hardware purchase.
safety: Do not modify the live DSP or vehicle configuration without separate authorization.
acceptance: Concurrent audio confirmed
Mute behavior isolates only digital source
No source switching or alert loss
notes: Critical gate before purchasing S/PDIF interface.

title: Test Commander and Dash coexistence
description: Measure whether passive Commander telemetry streaming leaves the installed Dash fully functional.
steps: Record Commander generation and firmware
Capture passive stream metadata only
Monitor Dash update continuity and connection state
Repeat across wake/sleep and reconnect cycles
expected: Evidence-backed decision on Commander telemetry path.
safety: Read-only only; never transmit CAN frames or vehicle commands.
acceptance: No Dash degradation or disconnect across agreed test cases
Latency and packet loss recorded
Reconnect behavior documented
notes: Fallback to independent read-only CAN if coexistence fails.

title: Identify Pi revision and test optical output
description: Identify exact Raspberry Pi model/revision and verify candidate interface on a bench.
steps: Read PCB model/revision
Check current HiFiBerry compatibility notes
Confirm supported OS overlay
Test 48 kHz stereo PCM and optical lock
expected: Known-good interface decision with repeatable bench evidence.
safety: Bench only; no vehicle connection.
acceptance: Exact board revision recorded
48 kHz stable optical output verified
No underruns over defined test interval
notes: Pi 4 Rev 1.5 caveat exists in manufacturer support material.

title: Verify Highland power architecture
description: Use current applicable Tesla service information and qualified installer input to establish a safe low-voltage supply plan.
steps: Identify market/production applicability privately
Review exact service information
Measure only via qualified installer with suitable instrumentation
Define wake/sleep and controlled shutdown behavior
expected: Approved power design inputs and failure response.
safety: Do not splice wiring or connect a generic 12 V adapter based on assumptions.
acceptance: Voltage/transient/fuse/current requirements evidenced
No unwanted parked draw
Power loss does not corrupt storage
notes: Tesla bulletin warns third-party wiring is unsupported and installer risk.

title: Build simulated telemetry synthesis prototype
description: Develop deterministic offline synthesis against synthetic inputs before vehicle integration.
steps: Define normalized test signal schema
Implement smoothed RPM/load mapping
Add bounded oscillator/resonator model
Implement stale telemetry fade-to-silence and limiter
Measure callback time and underruns
expected: Repeatable offline audio prototype with fault tests.
safety: No vehicle CAN integration in this task.
acceptance: All processing local
No unbounded allocations in audio callback
Stale/invalid data fades to mute
Latency budget measured
notes: Sound profiles must use original synthesis, not unlicensed recordings.

title: Complete speaker and DSP commissioning record
description: Work with qualified installer to complete speaker inventory, wiring, protection, routing and acoustic measurements.
steps: Use commissioning checklist in docs
Record measured values only
Back up before and after configuration
Verify original Tesla alerts
expected: Traceable DSP baseline and calibration record.
safety: Protect tweeters before enabling channels; no guessed crossover or gain values.
acceptance: Every physical channel mapped
All values measured/confirmed
Backup exports are restorable
Alerts verified
notes: Passenger woofer and tweeter split remain incomplete.

title: Measure end-to-end accelerator-to-audio latency
description: Measure physical response latency against the <50 ms project target after integrated system exists.
steps: Timestamp known telemetry edge
Capture digital and acoustic output on common clock
Repeat at least 100 transitions under CPU and thermal load
Report median, p95, maximum and dropouts
expected: Reproducible latency report.
safety: Only in authorized controlled test setting; no distracted driving tests.
acceptance: Measurement method and uncertainty documented
p95 below 50 ms or design revised
No clipping or dropouts
notes: Target is an engineering goal, not a guaranteed component property.
